points.description: Meter table: one sentence stating its function, namely that it holds meter entries/collects flow statistics that the controller uses to manage the network, for example for QoS or rate-limiting. Equivalent wording earns the mark. Stating only that it is a table of meters, with no function, does not earn it.

Flow pipeline: one sentence stating its function, namely that the flow tables hold rules/match fields and the actions applied to packets so the switch forwards them (the routing logic in the switch). Equivalent wording earns the mark. Stating only that the tables hold rules, with no forwarding or action role, does not earn it.

rubric.notes: Two distinct ideas, one per structure, each worth half the mark. Full marks need a correct one-sentence function for both the meter table and the flow-table pipeline. Equivalent wording and alternative phrasing earn the marks; the exact model-answer wording is not required.
